style: Style: match the attached reference image (the in-game look): Hollow Knight Silksong-like deformed, stylized character art, clean confident hand-inked outline, flat colors with soft painterly shading inside the shapes, NOT realistic, no skin pores, no photo detail. Dark, low saturation charcoal, sand and tarnished bronze palette with blood-red accents. No text, no watermark, no border, no shadow on the ground.

presets.part: 512x512 square, fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha channel). One single isolated portrait PART, FRONT view facing the viewer, horizontally centered, nothing else in the image (no other body parts, no background, no frame).

headRule: The face is a smooth BLANK area: NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO mouth (we add those as separate parts). Front view, slightly oversized rounded deformed proportions, short neck stub at the bottom. The head fills about 70% of the canvas height.
